# tempest-fastapi-sdk

> tempest-fastapi-sdk holds the shared FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2.0 (async) + Pydantic v2 building blocks used across Tempest services. Core: BaseAppSettings (+ composable settings mixins), BaseModel, BaseRepository[Model], BaseService, BaseController, base/pagination schemas, the AppException hierarchy + handlers (with an i18n message catalog and OpenAPI error documentation), AsyncDatabaseManager and AlembicHelper. Batteries: JWT/OAuth2 auth with a bundled signup/login/reset flow and TOTP MFA, a Django-style admin site, typed SSR pages, Server-Sent Events and WebSockets, Redis cache, FastStream queues and TaskIQ tasks (retries + dead letters), MinIO/S3 storage and uploads, Web Push, feature flags, audit trail, rate limiting and idempotency middleware, Prometheus metrics and OpenTelemetry tracing, self-hosted generative AI (local LLM, embeddings, RAG, speech), geolocation, Brazilian document/phone/PIX validation, and a `tempest` CLI that scaffolds services and generates typed clients from an OpenAPI spec. Python >= 3.12. Optional features ship as extras: [cli-ops], [cli], [auth], [email], [upload], [cache], [websocket], [webpush], [metrics], [queue], [queue-kafka], [queue-nats], [queue-redis], [tasks], [tasks-redis], [admin], [admin-sql], [minio], [storage-encryption], [http], [oidc], [openapi], [prometheus], [mfa], [webauthn], [firebase], [fastmcp], [pdf], [pdf-read], [pdf-layout], [slides], [slides-mermaid], [spreadsheet], [image], [vision], [genai], [genai-quant], [genai-rag], [genai-audio], [genai-tts-coqui], [genai-diarization], [faces], [genai-ollama], [genai-hosted], [genai-chroma], [genai-structured], [genai-onnx], [genai-vlm], [genai-hub], [genai-image], [genai-sound], [modelops], [modelops-compose], [modelops-onnx], [modelops-sklearn], [geo], [google-drive], [ssr], [sqlite], [postgres], [kurrentdb], [otel], [tests], [all].

Every link below is the Markdown source of a page, in English; the Portuguese original is the same path without `/en/`. [llms-core.txt](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/llms-core.txt) inlines the pages needed to start (installation, architecture, service standard, tutorial, recipe index); [llms-full.txt](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/llms-full.txt) inlines every page except the API reference.

## Home

- [tempest-fastapi-sdk](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/index.md): Entry point of the SDK: what you get out of the box, a five-minute quick start, where to go next and project status.

## Installation

- [Installation](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/installation.md): Use to install the SDK; covers the optional extras table, step-by-step GPU setup for `[genai-audio]`, the `tempest` CLI and the Python version policy.
- [Install uv](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/getting-started/uv.md): Use if you have never used Python tooling: install `uv`, verify it, enable shell completion, keep it updated and the map of everyday commands.
- [Pick your Python version](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/getting-started/python-versions.md): Use to pick and pin the Python version per project with `uv`; covers the version policy, `.python-version`, testing on three versions and common pitfalls.
- [Your first project](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/getting-started/first-project.md): Use to create your first project with the SDK; covers the from-scratch path file by file, the real-project shortcut and the five everyday commands.
- [Official reference docs](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/getting-started/references.md): Use when stuck on a tool question; a curated index of official docs for language, web, database, infrastructure, code quality and UI.

## Architecture

- [Architecture](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/architecture.md): Use to understand the router, controller, service, repository split; covers the required layout, exception envelope, layer patterns and `tempest lint-layers`.
- [Recommended architecture](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recommended-architecture.md): Use to shape every file in a service the way `tempest check` enforces; covers the nine coded rules, declared exceptions and migrating an existing service.
- [Service standard](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/service-standard.md): Use as the citable reference for laying out a Tempest service; covers what `tempest new` generates, each standard item with the gate enforcing it and `tempest generate --standard`.

## Tutorial

- [Tutorial — building the *Users* feature](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/tutorial.md): Use to learn the SDK conventions by building the Users feature end to end; covers layout, settings, model, schemas, exceptions, repository, service, controller, router and pagination.

## Recipes

- [Recipes](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/index.md): Recipes index: an SDK tour with one example per building block (auth, cache, queue, AI, admin, CLI) plus the full list of recipes and complete examples.
- [Admin site](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/admin.md): Use to get a Django-style admin panel under `/admin`; covers what it provides, installation and the index of per-task subpages.
- [Audit history](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/admin/audit.md): Use to show in the admin who changed what via `audit_model`, recent activity on the dashboard and restoring a version from history.
- [Custom actions](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/admin/actions.md): Use to add buttons that run your code via `@admin_action`: reveal a secret once, ask for input before running and create through a service.
- [Customize the look — `AdminTheme`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/admin/theme.md): Use to change the admin colors, logo, favicon, font, radius, footer and dark mode through typed `AdminTheme` parameters.
- [Dashboard: cards, indicators and map](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/admin/dashboard.md): Use to put business metrics on the admin dashboard: `dashboard_cards`, metric areas with thresholds and a geographic distribution map.
- [Form fields](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/admin/forms.md): Use to tune the admin form: `choices`, uploads, FK autocomplete, inlines, many-to-many, widgets, password fields and `exclude_fields`.
- [Global search](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/admin/search.md): Use for admin global search over `search_fields`; covers the per-model limit, what the search respects and the query limits.
- [List view: counts, import and bulk edits](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/admin/list.md): Use to boost the admin list view: related counts, CSV/XLSX import, duplicate, bulk edit, lenses and counting on large tables.
- [Mount the admin site](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/admin/setup.md): Use to stand up the admin panel: a `BaseUserModel` user model, registering admin classes or `automap`, the router, session defaults and a custom auth backend.
- [Permissions: RBAC, row scope and impersonation](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/admin/permissions.md): Use to control who sees and does what in the admin: `access_policy` per model and action, `row_scope` on reads and writes, and `impersonate`.
- [Storage browser — view, preview and edit files](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/admin/storage.md): Use to view, preview, upload, edit, rename and delete object-storage files from the admin with `StorageBrowserService`.
- [Task panel — what is scheduled and what ran](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/admin/tasks.md): Use to see the broker schedule and the runs a `JobStore` persisted from the admin, with `TaskPanelService`.
- [Timezone, concurrent edits and language](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/admin/operator.md): Use to show dates in the operator time zone, block concurrent edits with optimistic locking and switch the admin UI to Portuguese.
- [SQL console in the admin](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/admin-sql-console.md): Use to enable a SQL console in the admin with guardrails: capability policy, deny over allow, auditing, rolled-back reads and a production checklist.
- [AI agents](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/agents.md): Use to build an AI agent over local models; covers extra per backend, `stop_reason`, budget, typed tools, tool failures, HTTP serving and CPU cost.
- [AI agents (advanced)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/agents-advanced.md): Use when the basic agent is not enough: structured output, three-layer memory, on-demand skills, delegation, criterion and critique loops, and moderation.
- [AI agents (architecture)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/agents-architecture.md): Use once you outgrow one agent: folder layout with `runtime.py`, tools, schemas, views, `policy.py` and prompts, import direction, endpoint and auditing.
- [Agents: how they work inside](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/agents-concepts.md): Use before designing an agent: the loop internals, what the model sees, context cost, budgets, when to use a tool, skill or delegation, and failure modes.
- [AI agents (database)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/agents-db.md): Use when an agent tool queries the app database: a session per call, commit in the context manager, one manager per process and the `context` parameter.
- [AI agents (prompts)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/agents-prompts.md): Use to organize agent system prompts: the `prompts/` folder, anatomy, what the SDK already injects, per-request prompts, what to avoid and how to test.
- [Testing and validating an agent](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/agents-testing.md): Use to test an agent without relying on the model: minimal test, error recovery, budget, skills, memory, backend outage and when to use the real model.
- [AI agents (tools)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/agents-tools.md): Use to write agent tools that call an external API or structure free text; covers `@tool`, `typed_tool`, `text_tool`, `schema_of` and `final_answer_tool`.
- [App errors: when the client breaks in the user's hand](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/app-errors.md): Use to collect error reports from the client app (mobile/web); covers the table, the public endpoint, truncation, `user_id` from the token, filtered listing and rate limit.
- [Audit trail](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/audit-trail.md): Use to record an append-only create/update/delete history in the same transaction; covers `BaseAuditLogModel`, `add_audited`, `update_audited`, actor, origin and `columns=`.
- [Bundled auth flow (signup / activate / login / reset)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/auth-flow.md): Index of the local-account flow (signup, activation, login, reset) with `UserAuthService` and `make_auth_router`; maps each task to its subpage, plus security and recap.
- [Backend only: from signup to a protected route](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/auth-flow/backend-only.md): Use to test signup, activation, login and a protected route without a frontend (curl, Swagger, mobile); covers a one-file app, dev `.env` and the cycle in a test.
- [Change and recover an email](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/auth-flow/email-change.md): Use to change the email while logged in, re-verify the current one, recover an account with a lost inbox and renew the session with the refresh token.
- [Email disabled and SMTP down](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/auth-flow/email-failures.md): Use to know what each auth route answers with `EMAIL_ENABLED=false` or SMTP down, and when to use `AUTH_SEND_EMAILS_IN_BACKGROUND`.
- [Emails: anatomy, brand and templates](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/auth-flow/emails.md): Use to understand token, link and template in account emails, apply your brand and override the Jinja2 templates; covers the context variables and an example.
- [Endpoints](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/auth-flow/endpoints.md): Look up every auth-flow endpoint with payload and behaviour; covers closed systems, admin-created accounts, extra signup fields and attempt limits.
- [Five operating modes and local SMTP](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/auth-flow/modes.md): Use to pick among the five flow modes (production, local SMTP, no SMTP, CI, backend-only) and run Mailhog or smtp4dev with docker-compose.
- [Get the `current_user` from the request](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/auth-flow/current-user.md): Use to inject the authenticated user into your routes via `current_user_dependency()`; covers header/cookie/query order, `soft=True` and guards in the service.
- [Language of emails, pages and `/docs`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/auth-flow/i18n.md): Use to set the language (pt-BR/en-US) of auth emails and pages, store the user's preference, translate templates and choose the `/docs` language.
- [Minimum setup and `UserTokenModel`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/auth-flow/setup.md): Use to wire the auth flow from scratch: `[auth]`/`[email]` extras, `AsyncDatabaseManager`, `EmailUtils`, `UserAuthService`, `make_auth_router` and `UserTokenModel`.
- [Re-send activation and recover a password](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/auth-flow/recovery.md): Use when the activation email never arrived, the user forgot the password or wants to change it while logged in; covers re-send, password reset and logged-in change.
- [Settings: environment variables](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/auth-flow/settings.md): Look up the auth flow's environment variables by typed group: JWT, password, email, TTL, URLs, pages, language, token delivery, OAuth and deactivated accounts.
- [Token delivery: bearer, cookie or both](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/auth-flow/token-delivery.md): Use to decide whether the JWT pair goes in the body (bearer), in a cookie or both with `AUTH_TOKEN_DELIVERY`; covers cookie mode and both mode.
- [Your product's error codes](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/auth-flow/errors.md): Use to replace the auth flow's error codes with the ones your clients already handle, via `AuthExceptions`, without overriding methods.
- [Brazilian helpers](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/br-helpers.md): Use to validate and normalize Brazilian data: CPF, CNPJ, phone, CEP, state and city, money in reais, plus `utcnow`, `to_utc` and `modify_dict`.
- [Cache](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/cache.md): Use to cache expensive data in Redis; covers `AsyncRedisManager`, the `@cached` decorator, tag/namespace invalidation, cache-aside and negative caching.
- [Chat (conversations + messages)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/chat.md): Use to add chat with conversations and messages; covers the base tables, `ChatService` (replies, receipts, attachments, reactions, groups), `make_chat_router` and SSE.
- [Choosing a model](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/models.md): Use to pick an AI model through an enum instead of a string id; covers `TextModelEnum`, `EmbeddingModelEnum`, rerank, vision, image and audio, plus e5 role prefixes.
- [CLI](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/cli.md): Index of the `tempest` CLI (`[cli]` and `[cli-ops]` extras): scaffold a service and run quality gates; maps each command-line task to its subpage.
- [Docker: compose and Dockerfile](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/cli/docker.md): Use to generate `docker-compose.yaml` from the extras (with a `prod` profile and migrations), regenerate it in an existing project and generate the app Dockerfile.
- [Install and scaffold a service](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/cli/new-service.md): Use to choose between `[cli-ops]` and `[cli]`, scaffold a new service with `tempest new` and bring layers or an old project to the standard with `tempest generate`.
- [Integrations, agents and the OpenAPI contract](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/cli/integrations.md): Use to generate integrations and OpenAPI clients, simulate Mercado Pago, operate agents, export the OpenAPI contract and draft a PR description with `tempest pr-prompt`.
- [Layer rules: `tempest lint-layers`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/cli/lint-layers.md): Look up every architecture rule `tempest lint-layers` enforces (router, service, imports, file size, test suite), with its code, warning or error, and the fix.
- [Quality gates and `tempest check`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/cli/quality.md): Use to run the quality gates (ruff, mypy, pytest) from the CLI and know which SDK steps `tempest check` runs, including `lint-schemas`.
- [Queue, email, storage, flags, cache, models and doctor](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/cli/ops.md): Use to operate infrastructure from the CLI: queue and tasks, email test, object store, feature flags, cache, models and diagnostics with `tempest doctor`.
- [Routes, OpenAPI errors and permissions](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/cli/routes-openapi.md): Use to list routes, bundle a route for an AI (`tempest bundle-route`), document errors in OpenAPI and audit permission guards.
- [Schema metadata: `tempest lint-schemas`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/cli/lint-schemas.md): Use to require `title`, `description` and `examples` on schema fields that reach `openapi.json`, with the `tempest lint-schemas` command.
- [Serve, console and database](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/cli/run.md): Use to run the service (`tempest serve`), open the console (`tempest shell`) and operate the database with `tempest db`: squash, backup, restore, drift and seed.
- [Users and secrets](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/cli/users-secrets.md): Use to create and manage users from the CLI (password, MFA reset, deactivate) and generate, fill in and rotate `.env` secrets, including VAPID keys.
- [Comments + ratings](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/reviews.md): Use to add threaded comments and 0-to-5-star ratings to any entity without a table per type; covers `BaseCommentModel`, `BaseRatingModel`, the service and the router.
- [Fullstack web — SSR, WASM and server](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/fullstack-web.md): Use to build a fullstack tempestweb app in typed Python; three complete projects: SSR + HTMX, a Pyodide WASM SPA and WebSocket/SSE server mode.
- [GenAI examples — complete flows](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/genai-examples.md): Use to see complete self-hosted GenAI flows: load a model only if it fits, RAG over PDFs, SearXNG web grounding, a local voice assistant and a transcription endpoint.
- [Integrated example — a complete shop admin](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/admin-showcase.md): Use to see the admin panel features combined in one store app: audit history, FK autocomplete, inlines, cards, CSV import and SSE + Web Push alerts.
- [Integrated example — neighbourhood marketplace](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/marketplace-local.md): Use to see a neighborhood marketplace with the newer modules: nearby sellers via geo, real-time chat, star ratings and live notifications.
- [Integrated example — Pix checkout](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/integrated.md): Use to see an end-to-end Pix checkout: JWT auth, `@cached` pricing, outbox in the same transaction, background email and SSE + Web Push notification.
- [Complete service: settings, migrations, auth, upload and a test](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/full-service.md): Use to build a whole running service: settings from mixins, migration at startup, signup and login, a protected upload and an end-to-end test.
- [Computer vision (ONNX)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/vision.md): Use to expose ONNX detection, classification and segmentation as an API; covers response schemas and mappers, a combined graph, accepted inputs and `make_vision_router` with limits.
- [Data subject export and erasure (LGPD)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/subject-data.md): Use to fulfil LGPD/GDPR data-subject export and erasure requests; covers a schema built for deletion, a CI guard, exporting and erasing rows and files, and uploads under the subject prefix.
- [Database](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/database.md): Index of the database layer (SQLAlchemy 2.0 async, PostgreSQL/SQLite): model, connection, repository, filters, bulk, mixins, pagination, migrations and slow queries.
- [1. The base model](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/database/models.md): Use to declare tables with `BaseModel`: free columns, centralized table names, the constraint naming convention, composite uniques and `get_table_name()`.
- [2. Connect to the database](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/database/connection.md): Use to open the engine and sessions with `AsyncDatabaseManager`: per-request session, lifespan, health check, use outside a request and SQLite with WAL and foreign keys.
- [3. The repository](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/database/repository.md): Use for async CRUD with `BaseRepository`: direct or subclass mode, constraint errors, eager-loading, signals and `F`/`Q` expressions.
- [4. Convention-based filters](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/database/filters.md): Use to filter in the repository with `field__operator`; covers when a key or value is refused, how pagination inherits operators and the page-size wire name.
- [5. Bulk operations](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/database/bulk.md): Use to write many rows at once through the repository, keeping or bypassing the unit of work, including idempotent inserts with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.
- [6. Soft-delete and auditing (mixins)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/database/mixins.md): Use to add soft-delete (`SoftDeleteMixin`), `created_by`/`updated_by` and the user's preferred language to a model with opt-in mixins.
- [7. Pagination](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/database/pagination.md): Use to paginate in the repository by offset (page 3 of 12) or by cursor (large tables) and restrict sortable columns and page size.
- [8. Alembic migrations](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/database/migrations.md): Use for migrations with `AlembicHelper`: bootstrap, generate and apply revisions at startup, block schema drift in CI and migrate constraints from the old convention.
- [9. Detect slow queries](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/database/slow-queries.md): Use to log every query above a threshold with `SlowQueryLogger`, a listener attached to the engine at boot.
- [Downloads](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/downloads.md): Use to serve files with `DownloadUtils` from local disk or MinIO/S3; covers path traversal, streaming bytes, `Content-Type` and `Content-Disposition`.
- [Enum columns (safe on both databases)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/enum-columns.md): Use when mapping an enum to a column: what the SDK changes in SQLAlchemy defaults, `CHECK`, Postgres ENUM type and how to migrate, rename and downgrade.
- [Errors in OpenAPI (Swagger / ReDoc)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/openapi-errors.md): Use to document each route's error `code` values in Swagger; covers `code` on the exception, `error_responses`, `@raises` with `TempestAPIRouter` and `tempest openapi-errors --check`.
- [Event sourcing (event store)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/event-sourcing.md): Use to store facts instead of state; covers `SqlEventStore` and `KurrentDBEventStore`, optimistic concurrency, outbox, projections and aggregates.
- [Face recognition](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/faces.md): Use to detect faces and compare whether two photos show the same person with `FaceRecognizer`; includes the LGPD warning, model packs and measured margin.
- [Fakes: run the whole flow with no provider at all](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/fakes.md): Use to run and test the service with no real provider: fakes for Pix, card, email, text model, structured output, geo and files, and how to wire them.
- [Feature flags](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/feature-flags.md): Use to toggle features without redeploying with `FeatureFlags`; covers memory, env and Redis backends and the dependency that gates routes.
- [File on the service — `StoredFileServiceMixin`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/stored-files.md): Use when an entity holds one storage key (avatar, attachment); covers `StoredFileServiceMixin` with `set_file`, `file_url`, `file_urls` and `clear_file`, and multiple fields.
- [Firebase auth (ID token)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/firebase-auth.md): Use to verify the Firebase ID token sent by the app with `FirebaseAuth`; covers credentials, per-`code` errors, the soft variant, `check_revoked` and tests.

- [Server-side sessions](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/sessions.md): Use when you want server-side session auth instead of JWT; covers the comparison, `SessionAuth` setup, endpoints, settings, Memory/Redis stores, middleware and login without a user table.
- [Settings: composing the configuration mixins](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/settings.md): Use to build the service `Settings` class from the SDK mixins; covers base ordering, `BaseAppSettings` last, `*_kwargs()` for clients and a table of environment variables per mixin.
- [Sharing with a preview (Open Graph)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/share-preview.md): Use so links shared on WhatsApp or social networks show a preview; covers the per-item Open Graph page, unavailable items, the PNG card, cache and versioning, public link and Docker fonts.
- [Slides, answer keys and Markdown to PDF](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/slides.md): Use to turn lesson text into slides, answer keys or PDF; covers the first deck, vocabulary in the service language, output formats, Markdown to PDF with images and Mermaid, and HTTP serving.
- [Social login (OAuth2 / OIDC)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/oauth.md): Use for social login with Google, GitHub or OIDC that issues your own session; covers `make_auth_router`, the token-in-hand flow, email linking, linked accounts and `OIDCProvider`.
- [Spreadsheets (.xlsx)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/spreadsheets.md): Use to generate or read `.xlsx` spreadsheets; covers declared columns, Brazilian formats, live formulas, theming, download, reading Google Sheets and `.xlsx` files, and zip-bomb limits.
- [SSR: typed Python pages rendered to HTML](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/ssr.md): Use to render HTML pages from typed Python components; covers `Page`, `html_response`, `shell()`, widgets, `Style`, forms, local HTMX and serving a tempestweb build.
- [SSR actions: confirmation, flash and redirect back](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/ssr-actions.md): Use for SSR panel actions that confirm, notify and return to the originating screen; covers confirm-before-remove, read-once flash, redirect back without open redirect and exceptions.
- [Object storage — MinIO / S3](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/storage.md): Use to store objects in MinIO/S3 with `AsyncMinIOClient`; covers settings, upload, streaming, `X-Accel-Redirect`, signed and presigned URLs, batch operations and a private bucket over HTTPS.
- [Storage on local disk — `LocalObjectStorageClient`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/local-storage.md): Use to store files on local disk without an S3 server; covers `LocalObjectStorageClient`, links via the API, capped uploads, picking the backend by settings and encryption at rest.
- [Stripe (cards, subscriptions, Checkout)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/stripe.md): Use to charge cards, subscriptions or Checkout through Stripe with no extra; covers the minimal path, form-encoded bodies, currency, webhook verification, idempotency, pagination, errors and tests.
- [System checks (`tempest check-config`)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/system-checks.md): Use to validate configuration before serving traffic with `tempest check-config`; covers built-in checks, writing your own, failing at startup and the `EnvironmentSettings` production guard.
- [tempestweb frontend + tempest-fastapi-sdk backend](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/tempestweb-frontend.md): Use to connect a Python frontend (tempestweb) to an SDK backend over typed HTTP; covers the backend, the frontend, end-to-end idempotency, typed retry and CORS per origin.
- [Testing](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/testing.md): Use to build a test suite for an SDK service; covers `conftest.py` with lifespan, real login, a fake LLM, in-memory repositories, `testing` helpers, `ModelFactory` and the parallel suite.
- [Text search (LIKE + full-text)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/text-search.md): Use to search text over models; covers portable `search()` (LIKE) on PostgreSQL and SQLite, request-chosen fields, pagination and `full_text_search()` with per-field weights.
- [Transactional email](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/email.md): Use to send SMTP email with `EmailUtils`; covers `EmailSettings`, TLS vs SSL, attachments, `send_many`, Jinja2 templates and the disabled mode.
- [Transactional outbox (reliable events)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/outbox.md): Use to publish events atomically with the database write and avoid dual-write; covers the outbox table, same-transaction writes, the relay, retries and a one-shot drain.
- [Transactions (commit and savepoint)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/transactions.md): Use when a business rule does several writes that must commit together; covers `transaction()`, explicit `commit()`, `autocommit=False`, `savepoint()` and nesting.
- [Transcription pipeline — from audio to summary, in stages](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/transcription-pipeline.md): Use to stitch audio, transcription, summary and suggestions into a staged pipeline; covers state columns, cancelling a running job, per-user usage accounting and the screen.
- [Typed CSS (stylesheet and tokens)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/ui-css.md): Use to write CSS in Python checked by the type checker; covers rules as objects, design tokens from `tempest_core`, serving the sheet, the bundled sheet and failing on wrong class names.
- [Enforce typing (static + runtime)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/typing.md): Use to enforce static and runtime typing; covers linters, the pydantic plugin and `tempest_fastapi_sdk.mypy`, `[tool.tempest]`, `strict_types`, `typed` and `require_annotations`.
- [UI layer (pages and components)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/ui.md): Use when the service must return HTML through the `src/ui/` layer; covers the folder tree, a minimal example, ready-made components, layout, custom components and the scaffold.
- [Unified file store — `FileStoreUtils`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/file-store.md): Use when the service stores and serves the same file: `FileStoreUtils` unifies upload, download and presigned URLs over local disk or MinIO/S3.
- [Uploads — local disk + S3 / MinIO](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/uploads.md): Use to validate and store `UploadFile` on disk or MinIO/S3 with `UploadUtils`; covers extension allowlists, `ImageMediaTypeEnum`, magic bytes, `replace`, `write_stream` and migration.
- [Utilities](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/utilities.md): Use to find small base-SDK helpers; covers `utcnow`/`to_utc`, `get_client_ip`, opaque tokens, `generate_password`, `sign_path`, `form_encode` and color contrast.
- [Validated fields (ready-made types)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/fields.md): Use to declare pre-validated schema fields (`*Field` types for int, float, decimal, string, locale and Pix key) and compose your own.
- [Versioned artifact registry](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/artifact-registry.md): Use to version binaries swapped at runtime (ONNX models, bundles) with one current version per name; covers `ArtifactRegistry`, digest, manifest and admin action.
- [Wallet and Pix payouts](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/wallet.md): Use to keep a balance per person and pay Pix payouts without lost credits or double payouts; covers models, held credits, OpenPix or manual payouts, fees, `WalletLedger` and the router.
- [Web Push](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/webpush.md): Use to send VAPID Web Push notifications to browsers with `WebPushDispatcher`; covers VAPID config, model-to-router layers, the service worker payload and broadcast.
- [WebAuthn / passkeys](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/webauthn.md): Use to add phishing-resistant passkey login; covers the credentials table, settings, the router, the frontend, the multi-worker challenge store, account recovery and MFA interplay.
- [WebSocket client (AsyncAPI)](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/asyncapi-client.md): Use to generate a typed WebSocket client from an AsyncAPI spec; covers generation, usage, the two per-direction unions, validation and keeping it up to date.
- [WebSocket router](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/websocket.md): Use for a bidirectional channel with `make_websocket_router` and `WebSocketHub`; covers the required extra, handshake bearer auth, a JS client, per-user and topic broadcast, and heartbeat.
- [WhatsApp through zap-api](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/recipes/zap.md): Use to send WhatsApp messages through the zap-api gateway with the generated client; covers send versus delivery, idempotent retry, three media modes, `bytes` bodies and regeneration.

## Reference

- [API Reference](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference.md): Use to look up a symbol's signature, parameters and exceptions; index of the reference generated from the docstrings, by theme and module.
- [API Reference: Top-level surface](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/top.md): Use to find where a `from tempest_fastapi_sdk import X` name is documented; lists the root re-exports grouped by module, each linking its anchor.
- [API Reference: Admin, data and API](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/admin-data-api.md): Index of the admin, data and API modules: admin panel, models, repository, session, migrations, FastAPI wiring, auth, authz, sessions, exceptions, base schemas and settings.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.admin`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/admin-data-api/admin.md): Django-admin-style management UI for FastAPI services.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.admin.sql_shell`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/admin-data-api/admin-sql-shell.md): A SQL console for the admin, with a policy in front of it.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.admin.storage`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/admin-data-api/admin-storage.md): The storage browser's data source: one bucket of an object store.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.admin.tasks`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/admin-data-api/admin-tasks.md): The task panel's data source: declared schedule and persisted runs.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.api`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/admin-data-api/api.md): FastAPI integration primitives exposed at module level.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.auth`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/admin-data-api/auth.md): Bundled auth flow — signup, activation, password reset.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.authz`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/admin-data-api/authz.md): Object-level authorization primitives.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.cache`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/admin-data-api/cache.md): Async Redis cache, the `@cached` decorator and key/tag invalidation.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.core`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/admin-data-api/core.md): Core cross-cutting primitives: logging, context, configuration.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.db`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/admin-data-api/db.md): Database primitives exposed at module level.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.exceptions`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/admin-data-api/exceptions.md): Application exception primitives exposed at module level.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.schemas`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/admin-data-api/schemas.md): Pydantic schema primitives exposed at module level.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.services`, `tempest_fastapi_sdk.controllers`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/admin-data-api/services-controllers.md): The service and controller base classes, and the stored-file service mixin.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.sessions`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/admin-data-api/sessions.md): Server-side session module — store + service + middleware + router.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.settings`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/admin-data-api/settings.md): Application settings primitives exposed at module level.
- [API Reference: AI and computer vision](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/ai-vision.md): Index of the AI and vision modules: agents, self-hosted generative models, modelops (export, bench, quantization), computer vision, face recognition and fuzzy text search.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.agents`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/ai-vision/agents.md): AI agents over the models you already self-host.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.faces`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/ai-vision/faces.md): Face detection and recognition on ONNX Runtime.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.genai`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/ai-vision/genai.md): Self-hosted generative AI — run HuggingFace models on your own hardware.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.genai.audio`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/ai-vision/genai-audio.md): Self-hosted audio — speech-to-text and text-to-speech on your hardware.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.genai.hub`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/ai-vision/genai-hub.md): Weight lifecycle for the HuggingFace models a service self-hosts.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.genai.image`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/ai-vision/genai-image.md): Local image generation over HuggingFace diffusers.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.genai.inventory`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/ai-vision/genai-inventory.md): What is loaded in memory right now, and what it is costing.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.genai.rag`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/ai-vision/genai-rag.md): RAG context — feed LLMs with web search + PDF knowledge.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.modelops`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/ai-vision/modelops.md): Model ops — export, quantize and benchmark the models a service serves.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.text`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/ai-vision/text.md): Text matching without a model: normalization, edit distance, fuzzy lookup.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.vision`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/ai-vision/vision.md): Computer-vision inference integration (optional `[vision]` extra).
- [API Reference: Documents and files](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/documents-files.md): Index of the documents and files modules: PDF, spreadsheets, slides, object storage and upload, data export and erasure (LGPD), artifact registry and share preview.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.artifacts`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/documents-files/artifacts.md): Versioned binary artifact registry — DB-backed, activatable, digested.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.pdf`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/documents-files/pdf.md): PDF generation from HTML templates.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.privacy`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/documents-files/privacy.md): Data-subject export and erasure (LGPD art. 18, GDPR art. 15/17).
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.share`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/documents-files/share.md): Link previews for shared items: the Open Graph page and its card image.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.slides`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/documents-files/slides.md): Slide decks, answer keys and Markdown documents from plain text.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.spreadsheet`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/documents-files/spreadsheet.md): Spreadsheet generation — `.xlsx` documents a recipient can work with.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.storage`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/documents-files/storage.md): Object-storage primitives — MinIO / S3-compatible, or the local disk.
- [API Reference: Integrations and payments](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/integrations-payments.md): Index of the integration modules: payments contract, Mercado Pago, OpenPix, Stripe, RevenueCat, Google Drive upload, Pix wallet, WhatsApp gateway and app error reports.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.app_errors`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/integrations-payments/app-errors.md): Errors the client application reports back to the service.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.integrations.messaging.zap`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/integrations-payments/integrations-messaging-zap.md): zap-api — the in-house WhatsApp gateway.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.integrations.messaging.zap.inbox`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/integrations-payments/integrations-messaging-zap-inbox.md): The service layer every zap-api consumer writes: claim, track and send.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.integrations.messaging.zap.router`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/integrations-payments/integrations-messaging-zap-router.md): Opt-in FastAPI router receiving the zap-api webhook.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.integrations.payment.adapters`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/integrations-payments/integrations-payment-adapters.md): Providers translated into the canonical payment contract.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.integrations.payment.base`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/integrations-payments/integrations-payment-base.md): The canonical payment contract every bundled provider is mapped into.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.integrations.payment.mercado_pago`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/integrations-payments/integrations-payment-mercado-pago.md): The whole Mercado Pago surface, ready to import.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.integrations.payment.openpix`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/integrations-payments/integrations-payment-openpix.md): The whole OpenPix surface, ready to import.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.integrations.payment.routing`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/integrations-payments/integrations-payment-routing.md): Run two Pix providers side by side while moving from one to the other.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.integrations.payment.settlement`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/integrations-payments/integrations-payment-settlement.md): Confirm a Pix payment against the provider before releasing anything.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.integrations.payment.stripe`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/integrations-payments/integrations-payment-stripe.md): Stripe, from the API key to the verified webhook.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.integrations.storage.google_drive`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/integrations-payments/integrations-storage-google-drive.md): Google Drive: upload files into a shared folder as an `UploadUtils` backend.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.integrations.subscriptions.revenuecat`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/integrations-payments/integrations-subscriptions-revenuecat.md): RevenueCat: in-app subscriptions from the App Store and Google Play.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.wallet`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/integrations-payments/wallet.md): Wallet module — balance, ledger, holds and Pix withdrawals in integer cents.
- [API Reference: OpenAPI code generation](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/openapi.md): Index of the typed client generators: HTTP from an OpenAPI document (`tempest openapi-client`) and WebSocket from an AsyncAPI document.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.asyncapi`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/openapi/asyncapi.md): AsyncAPI 3.0: generating a typed WebSocket client from a document.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.openapi`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/openapi/openapi.md): Generate Pydantic schemas + a typed HTTP client from an OpenAPI spec.
- [API Reference: Real time and messaging](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/realtime-messaging.md): Index of the real-time modules: queue and tasks, WebSocket and rooms, SSE, Web Push and unified push, chat, comments, event sourcing, feature flags and MCP.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.chat`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/realtime-messaging/chat.md): Messenger building blocks — conversations, messages, media, receipts.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.eventsourcing`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/realtime-messaging/eventsourcing.md): Event sourcing — an event store protocol with SQL and KurrentDB backends.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.flags`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/realtime-messaging/flags.md): Feature flags: the service, the backends (memory, env, Redis, composite) and the FastAPI dependency.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.mcp`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/realtime-messaging/mcp.md): Model Context Protocol, both directions, over FastMCP.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.push`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/realtime-messaging/push.md): Unified push notifications — one API for browsers and phones.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.queue`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/realtime-messaging/queue.md): FastStream-backed message queue primitives.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.reviews`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/realtime-messaging/reviews.md): Reviews module — comments and 0-to-5-star ratings on any target.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.rooms`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/realtime-messaging/rooms.md): Online multiplayer rooms: a relay server for games, over WebSocket or TCP.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.sse`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/realtime-messaging/sse.md): Server-Sent Events helpers built on top of Starlette streaming.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.tasks`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/realtime-messaging/tasks.md): TaskIQ-backed background task primitives.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.webpush`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/realtime-messaging/webpush.md): Web Push (VAPID) dispatch and subscription schemas.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.websockets`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/realtime-messaging/websockets.md): WebSocket primitives — authenticated router + connection hub.
- [API Reference: Web, UI and utilities](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/web-ui-utils.md): Index of the web and utilities modules: SSR pages and the `ui` layer, utilities, geolocation, host control, system checks and the testing tools.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.checks`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/web-ui-utils/checks.md): System-check framework — Django-style startup / config validation.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.geo`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/web-ui-utils/geo.md): Geolocation — distance, routing, geometry and geocoding, no paid API.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.hostbridge`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/web-ui-utils/hostbridge.md): Control the machine a service runs on — power, files, PDFs, commands.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.ssr`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/web-ui-utils/ssr.md): Server-side rendering: typed Python components rendered to HTML.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.testing`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/web-ui-utils/testing.md): Test helpers shared across SDK consumers.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.testing.fakes`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/web-ui-utils/testing-fakes.md): Stand-ins for the third parties a service talks to.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.ui`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/web-ui-utils/ui.md): The UI layer: typed pages, components, forms and CSS — all in Python.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.ui.components`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/web-ui-utils/ui-components.md): Components: the reusable pieces pages are built from.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.ui.css`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/web-ui-utils/ui-css.md): Typed CSS: stylesheets, design tokens and the route that serves them.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.ui.forms`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/web-ui-utils/ui-forms.md): Forms generated from Pydantic schemas, and parsed back into them.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.ui.layout`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/web-ui-utils/ui-layout.md): Layout: the structural containers a page arranges its content in.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.ui.pages`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/web-ui-utils/ui-pages.md): Pages: one class per screen, composed of components.
- [API Reference: `tempest_fastapi_sdk.utils`](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/reference/web-ui-utils/utils.md): Shared utility helpers exposed at the module level.

## Learning projects

- [Learning projects](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/learning/index.md): Index of learning projects built on the SDK, with business rules, UML, endpoint map and tests; how to use the section and planned projects.
- [🛒 Product marketplace](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/learning/marketplace/index.md): Use to start the multi-tenant marketplace project: project pages, five-minute setup, SDK stack exercised, suggested layout and implementation order.
- [Business rules — Marketplace](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/learning/marketplace/business-rules.md): Use to learn the marketplace domain contract: numbered MUST/MAY rules for users, orgs, invites, stock, cart, orders, reviews and quotas.
- [Domain model](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/learning/marketplace/domain.md): Use to model the marketplace: UML class diagram, physical ER, enums, invariants and the mapping of each entity to an SDK primitive.
- [Critical flows](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/learning/marketplace/flows.md): Use to implement the marketplace critical flows: sequence diagrams for signup, invites, idempotent checkout, SSE + Web Push and state machines.
- [Endpoint map](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/learning/marketplace/api.md): Use to look up the marketplace REST API in one table: auth, orgs, invites, catalog, stock, orders, reviews, notifications and a checkout payload.

## Roadmap

- [Roadmap](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/roadmap.md): Use to see what the SDK already ships and what is in the backlog; covers tiers S, A and B with status and version, admin panel evolution, next steps and per-version deliveries.

## Migration guide

- [Migration guide](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/migration.md): Use when upgrading the SDK across breaking changes; index of the per-version-range subpages and the list of all changes by release.
- [Migration 0.37x](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/migration/0-37x.md): Use when upgrading from before 0.374.0: text-written tool calls in `Agent`, strict schemas, `ResponseT` in controller/service and new `tempest check` rules.
- [Migration 0.36x](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/migration/0-36x.md): Use when upgrading from before 0.366.0: a custom `RoutingBackend` needs `route_through` and `matrix`, and manual payouts gain four columns.
- [Migration 0.34x–0.35x](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/migration/0-34x-0-35x.md): Use when upgrading from before 0.353.0: `gemini_kwargs()`, the Coqui extra, `Enum` suffix on every enum, required `ENV` and signup, Web Push and SSE changes.
- [Migration 0.33x](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/migration/0-33x.md): Use when upgrading from before 0.336.0: security fixes in SSE, CORS and storage, the `email_verified_at` column, DLQ ack, admin look and push ownership.
- [Migration 0.32x](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/migration/0-32x.md): Use when upgrading from before 0.327.0: `tempest check` architecture rules, admin login CSRF, `[cli-ops]`, dead-letter, SMTP as 503 and the email guard.
- [Migration 0.31x](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/migration/0-31x.md): Use when upgrading from before 0.319.0: `bulk_upsert` counts, Python 3.12 minimum, MFA on social login and reset, `Enum` suffix and `amr` on refresh.
- [Migration 0.30x](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/migration/0-30x.md): Use when upgrading from before 0.309.0: unknown `filters` keys, CLI moved to `[cli]`, the `totp_last_step` column, `inline` downloads and new token rules.
- [Migration 0.27x](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/migration/0-27x.md): Use when upgrading from before 0.274.0: only the newest account link works, stricter checks, `PixCharge.raw` in wire spelling and `PaymentStatus.UNKNOWN`.
- [Migration 0.26x](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/migration/0-26x.md): Use when upgrading from before 0.269.0: OpenPix field types, generic `AdminAuthBackend`, the WebSocket `hello` frame and renamed OpenPix methods.
- [Migration 0.25x](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/migration/0-25x.md): Use when upgrading from before 0.259.0: OpenPix money as `int`, log rotation, `tools` in agent fakes, JSON 429 and per-session SQLite `:memory:`.
- [Migration 0.22x–0.23x](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/migration/0-22x-0-23x.md): Use when upgrading from before 0.234.0: generated models built by Python name, renamed OpenPix enums and Ollama structured output via `/api/chat`.
- [Migration 0.8–0.17x](https://mauriciobenjamin700.github.io/tempest-fastapi-sdk/en/migration/0-8-0-17x.md): Use when upgrading from before 0.174.0: 500s that became 422s, token and cache scoping, `BaseAppSettings` as last base, the `payload` column and `ServerSettings`.
